Subject: POC: plan & timeline — success criteria / kickoff / weekly check-ins

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC plan in: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference latency and cost at 95th percentile on your document-search chatbot workload (search + short generative answers).
- Primary success criteria: 
  * 95th-pctl latency <= 350ms for typical query mix (50% short queries, 30% medium, 20% long)
  * Token cost below $0.0009/token (target) with quality within 5% of baseline human evals
  * Integration: embedding + rerank + generation end-to-end working with your search pipeline

Proposed evaluation plan & roles:
- Redwood: Marissa (POC lead), Vivek (SE — integration + performance tuning), Michael (CS — onboarding & metrics).
- Acme: Ian (product owner), Leah (eng lead — infra & SSO), Samantha (security reviewer).

Timeline & milestones (proposed):
1) Week 0 (Jun 9): Kickoff & environment swap — share test dataset, access, and run initial baseline.
2) Week 1 (Jun 16): Integration complete (embeddings + reranker hooked up), baseline latency/cost observed.
3) Week 2 (Jun 23): Performance tuning + quantization profile applied; preliminary cost reductions measured.
4) Week 3 (Jun 30): Final run and readout; success criteria assessment and next-steps conversation.

Weekly cadence:
- Weekly 30-min check-ins on Tuesdays at 10:00 PT (tentative).

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.xlsx (detailed metrics spreadsheet), redwood-poc-sow-v1.pdf (SOW draft).

Immediate asks for Acme: please confirm (a) the success criteria above, (b) internal owners for each milestone, and (c) whether Jun 9 kickoff works for your team.

I'll follow up with calendar invites and a shared Drive folder once we confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
